comment: Houses: what a blueprint builds, in which stages, from which material packs. Read by src/content/housing.ts. Each stage is finished by hauling its material packs to the site (on your back or in a cart) and paying its labor. Tax is copper per real day of world time, paid at the Land Registry.

stages.name: Walls
stages.desc: Fill the walls and set the door.

stages.name: Roof
stages.desc: Thatch the roof and fit the chimney.
